flags.text: "Add inline citation badges anchored to matching titles in assistant answers, with tooltip previews and a sources-list fallback. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))" - PR #244 says its integration removed #233’s AnswerCitationLayout and tests, kept citations in the sources list, and deferred inline badges. PR #245 later reintroduced inline badges over sanitized Markdown. Presenting #233’s implementation as a release addition is misleading.
"**Agent roster in assistant replies:**" - The active roster is injected into the assistant’s system prompt, not necessarily included in its replies.

"**Grounding checks:** After knowledge-base passages are retrieved, the assistant now runs a grounding check before streaming its first answer token if it has not already checked." - The check is forced before the first streamed token when passages are present and no check has run, but the mechanism guarantees only one check after retrieval—not a new check after every retrieval.

"**Meaning-based grounding checks:** Grounding checks now compare answer sentences with retrieved passages by meaning, so supported paraphrases and translations can be recognized." - The semantic evaluator scores embedding similarity; the facts report deterministic fake-embedder tests, not live validation that supported paraphrases and translations are recognized in practice.
